Campaign Roadmap

Timeline

9–12 Sep

Phase 1 — Launch Campaign

Launch the campaign page, publish the fund wallet and budget, announce the transparency rules, and invite the community to participate.

13–18 Sep

Phase 2 — Community Build

Create artwork, short-form content, multilingual posts, fan stories, and campaign updates while publicly reporting contributions and expenses.

Final −7 Days

Phase 3 — Final Push

Daily countdown, fan messages, official-performance sharing, social promotion, and verified voting/streaming information when officially published.

Final Week

Phase 4 — Final Week / Final Day

72h / 48h / 24h countdowns, community fan wall, coordinated support messages, and official viewing/voting reminders.

+1–7 Days

Phase 5 — Transparency Report

Publish total contributions, campaign expenses, public transaction references, remaining balance, and the next community decision.

Transparency

100% Transparent Community Fund

✓ Separate Community Fund wallet
✓ Public Solana address
✓ Incoming support and campaign expenses reported
✓ Expense log and post-campaign report
✓ No founder or treasury-wallet mixing
Important

Community Support, Not Investment
